appended_DRC_rules:
# Maintain the previous effective .20 minimum everywhere outside exact necks.
(rule "Effective general track minimum remains .20" (condition "A.Type == 'Track' || A.Type == 'Arc'") (constraint track_width (min 0.20mm)))
(rule "U1001 exact assigned F signal necks only" (layer "F.Cu")
 (condition "A.Type == 'Track' && A.Width < 0.20mm && A.enclosedByArea('U1001_LITERAL_SIGNAL_NECKS') && (A.NetName == '/FPGA_CRESET_N' || A.NetName == '/FPGA_USER_RESET_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CDONE' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_CBSEL0' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_CBSEL1' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_CBUS0' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_CBUS1' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_CBUS2' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_CSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_NSTATUS' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CFG_TEST_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_CLK_50M' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_FLASH_CCK_SOURCE' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_FLASH_CS_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_FLASH_MISO' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_FLASH_MOSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/FPGA_LOCAL_RESET_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/HOST_SPI_CS_CMD_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/HOST_SPI_CS_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/HOST_SPI_MISO' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/HOST_SPI_MOSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/HOST_SPI_SCLK' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L0_CS_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L0_MISO' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L0_MOSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L0_SCLK' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L1_CS_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L1_MISO' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L1_MOSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L1_SCLK' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L2_CS_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L2_MISO' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L2_MOSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L2_SCLK' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L3_CS_N' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L3_MISO' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L3_MOSI' || A.NetName == '/fpga_core/IOL1_L3_SCLK')")
 (constraint track_width (min 0.15mm) (max 0.15mm))
 (constraint track_segment_length (max 1.0mm)))
